tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtse gdong rin sgang spyi bor gnang ba// srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun gyi rtse/ /legs byas mngon sum grub pa'i gdong / /tshig don lag len rin chen gyi/ /sgang gnas gzur gnas la springs pa/ /sngon byon bshad sgrub bstan pa'i ring / /dus ngan rlung gis thal ba'i shul/ /las smon kho bos zil mnan pa'i/ /gsang chen smra ba'i chos grwa che'i/ /phyag na gdan sa gong gi srol/ /gsang chen yang dag rtser son zhing / /sngon byon phyag bzhes seng chen gdong / /deng sang g.yu ral gsos rtags su/ /rin chen slob pa 'di yin zhes/ /sgang gnas tshig 'di kho bo yis/ /go ba'i rjes su nyer 'brang nas/ /rab byung bcu gsum dge byed lo'i/ /smin zla'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad nas/ /mdzes byed lo yi mgo tshes bar/ /theg pa rim dgu'i zhag grangs der/ /'dus tshogs grangs ni 'di zhes bya'i/ /dpal ldan gur mgon las mtha' gtor/ /drug cu'i cho ga rtsod pa can/ /a mes zhabs dang kho bo yis/ /sa lo'i bzhed gzhung srog bzung ba/ /'dzugs bkod mchod gtor dge 'dun la/ /bsnyen bkur la sogs gtong bzhi'i deb/ /srid mthar gnas pa'i dan khra zhig /cis kyang lhur len de'i rgyu mtshan/ /rtse gdong gong ma'i zhal slob rnams/ /rin chen sgang du rgan gtam ni/ /phug ron gad chags ded byung zhing / /khyad par gong ma bsod nams dang / /ye shes dbang gi rgyal po de'i/ /zhing 'di'i mdzad pa gnas der bsdus/ /gong gi rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan lcags bya'i lo/ /gshegs nas bug lnga'i phyogs kyi lor/ /kho bo sa skya kun blo btsas/ /dge byed dbus ljongs 'phan yul gyi/ /bya khra nang so sprul pa'i sku/ /mkhas grub 'gran bral de nyid bltams/ /nyer gsum kun 'dzin lo la ni/ /kho bo'i lag tu gdan sa 'god/ /sngar bzhin gso ba'i sta gon mdzad/ /chos spyod sgrub dkyil bskang gtor bzlog /de sogs rtse gdong rnying dus bzhin/

/'khrul med nges tshe des chog mod/ /'on kyang bstan pa nyams ches pas/ /tshang ma 'di yin mi bzhugs kyang / /rags tsam da lta rin sgang gi /lag len 'di dang mthun no zhes/ /sprul pa'i sku des bka' gnang la/ /ji mi snyam pa'i blo med mod/ /gdan sa gong na yab chos mchog /dpal ldan phur pa'i stod smad gzhung / /brtag gnyis bde kye yab yum bka'/ /gsang 'dus kun rig tshe dpag med/ /tshogs kyi phyag len dar ba dang / /chos spyod bskang ba gtor bzlog sogs/ /shin tu dar 'di phyogs der yang / /'phel na bstan 'gror phan snyam pa'i/ /lhag bsam kho nas dbang byas te/ /'dus sde gsang chen smra ba'i gling / /ngo mtshar gsar bskrun 'di lta dang / /dben dgon rin chen mtshan 'chang ba/ /sngar srol ji bzhin bzhag 'di la/ /khyed rnams las dang skal ldan pas/ /'byung khungs drang gtam yi rangs bcas/ /ci nas bstan srol 'dzin pas na/ /kun kyang re ba smin zhig bu/ /de skad sa skya kun blo des/ /smin grol chad med 'chad skabs nas/ /mang ja'i rten dang bcas te bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rtse gdong rin sgang spyi bor gnang ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
